per_item_alternatives.argument: The local carrier defines a prescribed Maxwellian relaxation operator and explicitly disclaims binary-collision or microscopic derivation. Tong §2.5.1 is used only for the approximation context, so the inaccessible original paper is not needed to establish the Definition.

The exact homogeneous solution, moment conservation, uniqueness in the stated weighted Banach class, and convergence rates are derived directly from the local BGK Definition and Gaussian moment calculation.
The entropy estimate is proved from the explicit local solution, moment cancellation in log M, and convexity of z log z minus z plus one; it does not rely on the original paper's derivation.
The initial layer is an explicit two-Gaussian mixture substituted into the local exact homogeneous solution; its moment and entropy conditions are checked in the B carrier.
